author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — Q1 + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface (throwaway)
- Two short-lived branches: `spike/mobile-tauri`, `spike/mobile-pwa`. NOT merged.
- Each branch produces a runnable mobile artifact on iOS + Android.
- Measurement protocol checked into `.design/m5/44-mobile-app-spike-results.md` at end of spike.

## Measure
1. iOS push notification latency: backend → device. Median + p95 over 50 fires.
2. Android push notification latency: same.
3. Build path: from clean clone to running on device. Wall-clock + step count.
4. Bundle size: Tauri Mobile shell vs PWA service-worker delta.
5. Auth flow: ASWebAuthenticationSession (iOS) / Custom Tabs (Android) ↔ Polaris OAuth completes end-to-end on each.

## Rust-quality notes
- Spike is throwaway code; rust-quality bar is lower (no comprehensive tests, no doctests). But any code that LANDS afterward must be at full bar.
- Document the measurement protocol BEFORE measuring so retroactive bias is harder. Commit the protocol as part of the spike branches.
- Per architect skill: a 1-week spike with two viable branches + an evidence-document is dramatically cheaper than locking in a wrong platform choice for a year. Time-box hard.

## External references
- Tauri Mobile setup: https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/#mobile-targets
- Leptos on Tauri: https://github.com/leptos-rs/leptos/discussions/2002
- PWA iOS push support (iOS 16.4+): https://webkit.org/blog/13878/web-push-for-web-apps-on-ios-and-ipados/

## Acceptance
- [ ] Two spike branches built and pushed.
- [ ] `.design/m5/44-mobile-app-spike-results.md` exists with measurement data + recommendation.
- [ ] Decision recorded as `--kind decision` comment on #114.

## Blocks
- Blocked by #114 (Q-resolution provides the scope of A vs B vs C).
- Blocks #116 (platform decision shapes the backend push subsystem's client integration).
